scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @md-viewer/web build && node scripts/move-build.mjs apps/web/dist builds/web
scripts.build:tauri: pnpm --filter @md-viewer/tauri tauri build && node scripts/move-build.mjs apps/tauri/src-tauri/target/release/bundle builds/tauri
scripts.build:macos: pnpm --filter @md-viewer/tauri tauri build --bundles app && node scripts/move-build.mjs apps/tauri/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos builds/macos
scripts.build:android: pnpm --filter @md-viewer/tauri tauri android build --apk --target aarch64 && apps/tauri/scripts/sign-android-apk.sh && node scripts/move-build.mjs apps/tauri/src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/release/md-viewer.apk builds/android/md-viewer.apk
